breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the conflicting instructions for defining the spatial grid. The incomplete prompt provided a general rule for periodic domains (dx=1/Nx) but then added a contradictory instruction for this specific task (dx=1/(Nx-1)). The agent removed this contradiction and correctly specified the grid using only the consistent definition: 'dx = 1/Nx', which matches the ground truth.
